name: Inran Miko to Kyonyuu Maid to Kon'yoku Onsen
original_name: 淫乱巫女と巨乳メイドと混浴温泉
source:
Main character goes to hot springs resort with his girlfriend and is anxious to have his first sex  there. But first he is interrupted first by inn maid, then by shrine maiden. Will he succeed?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-june-2006-h2o-footprints-in.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公与女友一同前往温泉旅馆，满心期待在那里迎来自己的初体验。然而，他先是被旅馆女侍打断，接着又被巫女搅局。他最终能够如愿吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-june-2006-h2o-footprints-in.html]vndbreview[/url]]
